name: Voxel Ray Marching with BVH Acceleration
definition: A compute shader-based ray tracing technique for voxel data. It uses a Bounding Volume Hierarchy (BVH) to accelerate ray-mesh intersection tests for lighting (sun) and ambient occlusion (AO) calculations. The method operates on a per-pixel basis in a compute shader, utilizing position and normal textures as input buffers.
summary: Voxel Ray Marching with BVH Acceleration is a compute-shader technique for screen-space lighting that uses a Binary Volume Hierarchy to accelerate ray-mesh intersection tests for voxel data.
